context.focus: Additive migrations, backfills, dual-read or dual-write cutovers, reconciliation, rollback, and source retention.
forbidden_scope: deleting or replacing prior architecture artifacts
design work before workflow contracts pass
invented market demand, search volume, customers, reviews, rankings, backlinks, citations, or performance
mass-generated public pages or keyword permutations

definition_of_done: Every prior dataset has an explicit preservation and transfer strategy.
Migrations use expand-migrate-contract and are non-destructive by default.
Each transfer defines field mappings, reconciliation checks, rollback, and source retention.
Contract or deletion steps require separate explicit approval and are never automatic.

After the owned section passes, append or update agent_evidence for migration_safety_agent with status done, at least one scoped check in checks_passed, and an empty checks_failed list. Unfinished downstream stages are dependencies, not failures of this task.
